execution.description: Ran the cooling construction, campaign and capability-registry tests after introducing canonical finite-choice tokens.

expected: The contract should compile exact calibration-grid choices, reject off-grid tokens, verify public material and preserve challenge dispatch.
observed: All 40 applicable tests passed; one POSIX campaign-controller test skipped on Windows and one deliberately excluded monkeypatch case was not selected. The guarded recipe maps stable choice tokens to the exact published floating-point values only after B-02B validation.
keep: Expose the token-to-value map in discovery so the declarative boundary remains easy to use.
Keep physical values inside the Challenge adapter and the shared compiler dispatch parameterized by Challenge.
